chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Fuḍayl al-Baṣrī wrote to Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, asking him about whether the guardian should pay Zakat al-Fiṭrah on behalf of the orphans if they have wealth.
So he عليه السلام wrote: “There is no zakat upon an orphan.”

key_terms.الْوَصِيِّ: the guardian or executor responsible for managing the orphan’s affairs
key_terms.زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fiṭrah due at the end of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: Is Zakat al-Fiṭrah obligatory on orphans who have wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام regarding Zakat al-Fiṭrah for orphans. He states that no zakat is due upon an orphan, clarifying the ruling even when the orphan possesses wealth under a guardian’s care.
